# 山行接駁 Go Hike（gohike.tw）完整資料 / full reference

> 山行接駁是台北、台中出發的登山接駁包車服務，接送玉山、雪山・武陵四秀、合歡山群峰、大霸尖山、南湖大山、奇萊南華、嘉明湖、松蘿湖、羅馬縱走、高島縱走、塔曼山、北得拉曼、郡大山、霞喀羅古道等登山口，提供五人座（最多 4 位乘客）與九人座（最多 8 位乘客）兩種車型，整車計價。詢價請用 LINE（ID 0910321666）、WhatsApp、Email（taipei.cars@gmail.com）或網站上的詢價表單。
>
> Go Hike (山行接駁) is a hiking shuttle from Taipei and Taichung to trailheads including Yushan / Jade Mountain, Xueshan / Snow Mountain & Wuling Four Peaks, Hehuanshan peaks, Dabajian, Nanhu Mountain, Qilai South Peak & Nanhua, Jiaming Lake, Songluo Lake. We have a 5-seat car (up to 4 passengers) and a 9-seat van (up to 8 passengers), priced per vehicle. Ask on WhatsApp (+886910321666), LINE (ID 0910321666), email (taipei.cars@gmail.com) or with the form on this page.

## 服務內容

- 登山接駁包車：從台北車站、台中高鐵站或指定地址出發，專車直達登山口；下山時在登山口接回市區。
- 行程：當日來回、兩天、三天以上都可以預約。
- 車型：五人座（最多 4 位乘客）、九人座（Volkswagen Caravelle 或同級，最多 8 位乘客）。
- 計價：整車計價，不是按人頭。單程是一趟車；來回是去程、回程各一趟；一天來回是當天送上山、等下山再載回。
- 入園入山申請、山屋、保險與裝備由乘客自行準備；詢價時可提供入山證、山屋的申請資訊。
- 付款：訂金可用匯款、LINE Pay，海外旅客可用 PayPal；尾款以新台幣現金或匯款支付。
- 取消：出發三日前可全額退費取消或改期；遇封山或官方管制，可於出發前一日取消。
- 詢價請用 LINE、WhatsApp（+886910321666）、Email 或網站表單（司機行車中不便接聽電話）。

## 常見問題

**如何預約接駁？**
請提供登山路線、出發及回程日期、搭乘人數、上車地點及預計時間。我們會確認行程與車輛安排後提供報價。雙方確認費用及接送條件，並完成約定的訂金支付後，才算預約成立。

**預約需要付訂金嗎？**
確認車輛與行程後，我們會提供正式報價及訂金付款資訊。訂金金額、尾款支付時間及方式均會在確認預約前告知，完成訂金支付後保留接送車輛。

**可以使用哪些付款方式？**
訂金可用匯款或 LINE Pay，海外旅客可用 PayPal；尾款以新台幣現金或匯款支付。我們會在確認報價時提供付款資訊與期限，海外旅客請先告知付款所在地，我們將確認適合的支付方式。

**如果行程取消或需要改期怎麼辦？**
出發三日前通知，可全額退費取消或改期。如遇封山或官方管制，可於出發前一日取消。

**網站價格就是最後付款價格嗎？**
網站價格為指定出發區域、車型及行程類型的整車參考費用。實際報價將依上車地點、接送時間、停靠需求、行程天數及道路條件確認。若有額外費用，會在預約成立前列明；行程確認單也會註明未包含的其他費用，例如私人登山口、入園費、停車費。

**接駁費用包含什麼？哪些要另外準備？**
網站價格是整台車的接駁費用：從上車地點送到登山口，或從登山口接回市區，五人座最多 4 位乘客、九人座最多 8 位乘客。私人登山口、入園費、停車費等其他費用不在網站價格內，會註明在行程確認單上。入園入山申請、山屋或營地、登山保險和裝備請自行準備，詢價時我們可以提供入山證、山屋的申請資訊。

**費用怎麼算？**
以整台車計價，有五人座和九人座兩種車型，台北、台中出發都可以，單程 NT$5,000 起，各路線的價格列在上面的收費表。收費表上沒有價格的走法或沒列出的登山口，把目的地、日期、人數傳給我們，我們會回覆一個明確的金額。

**單程、來回、一天來回有什麼差別？**
單程：從市區送往登山口，或從登山口接回市區。來回：去程、回程兩段行程接駁，分別在約定的日期接送，行程確認單會註明。一天來回：同一天送往登山口，依事先約定的時間接回。

**如果下山時間比預計晚，司機會等嗎？**
起登前，我們會再次和您確認下山時間及地點，並在約定時間等您。我們了解登山行程可能受體力、天候與路況影響。為了方便安排回程接送，請盡可能在行程中更新預計下山時間。接送等待時間、可能產生的額外費用及緊急聯絡方式，均會在預約時事先確認。

**可以臨時更改上車地點或增加停靠站嗎？**
如需從飯店、住家或其他指定地點出發，請在詢價時告知地址。我們將依行車距離、路線與車輛調度確認是否能安排，並事先提供額外費用。臨時變更則需視當日路況及行程安排而定。

**如果登山口因道路封閉或管制，車輛無法抵達怎麼辦？**
山區道路可能因天候、施工、災害或主管機關管制而影響通行。我們會依最新道路資訊確認合法且可安全抵達的接送地點。若車輛無法進入原定地點，將與您討論替代集合點、調整出發時間或改期安排。若最終無法履行原定交通服務，將依適用法規及雙方約定處理退費。

**九人座真的可以坐八位乘客加八個大背包嗎？**
九人座最多可搭乘 8 位乘客，但實際行李空間會受背包大小、件數及車款配置影響。如果每位旅客都攜帶大型登山背包，請在詢價時告知背包容量及件數，我們會協助評估適合的車型及載運方式。

**是什麼車？最多可以坐幾個人？**
有兩種車型：五人座最多可載 4 位乘客；九人座是 Volkswagen Caravelle 或同級車款，最多可載 8 位乘客。人數或大背包比較多的時候，請在詢價時先告訴我們，我們幫你建議車型。

**沒列在網站上的登山口可以去嗎？**
可以問。網站上列的是最常跑的路線，其他登山口請在表單選「其他登山口」並在備註寫下地點。

**入園、入山證和山屋要自己申請嗎？**
要。我們負責的是交通接駁，入園入山申請、山屋或營地、登山保險和裝備都請自行準備；詢價時我們可以提供入山證、山屋的申請資訊。

**從香港、馬來西亞、新加坡來，可以預約嗎？**
可以。詢價表單可以填 +852、+60、+65 等國際號碼，或只留 Email，並選擇你方便的聯絡方式（WhatsApp、LINE 或 Email）。請一併寫下航班抵達日期和偏好語言，我們確認車輛與行程後回覆報價。

**海外旅客要怎麼付款？**
訂金可用 PayPal，也可以用匯款或 LINE Pay；尾款以新台幣現金或匯款支付。詢價時請先告知付款所在地，我們會在報價時確認適合的支付方式。

**從台北到登山口要開多久？**
依路線不同：合歡山約 4 小時，玉山塔塔加約 4.5–5 小時，嘉明湖向陽登山口約 7–8 小時。剛抵達台灣的話，建議預留足夠的交通與休息時間，每條路線的車程寫在路線頁上。

**海外旅客也要自己申請入園、入山嗎？**
要。我們負責交通接駁，入園入山申請、山屋或營地、登山保險和裝備都請自行準備。詢價時我們可以提供入山證、山屋的申請資訊，各路線頁也有官方申請網站的連結。

## 各路線介紹

### 玉山主峰登山接駁：挑戰台灣第一高峰

網址：https://gohike.tw/routes/yushan/

- 登山口／接送點：塔塔加（南投信義）
- 台北車程：約 4.5–5 小時
- 海拔：3,952 m
- 行程類型：兩天

景觀：海拔 3,952 公尺，台灣最高峰。站上主峰，可以欣賞中央山脈與周圍群峰的壯闊山景。
適合客群：有中高海拔登山經驗、希望完成台灣最高峰挑戰的山友；尤其適合海外組隊挑戰百岳。
交通與注意事項：從台北約 4.5–5 小時車程，接送以塔塔加可通行區域為準；塔塔加至玉山登山口另涉及管制路段及當地接駁。

價格（整車，新台幣）：
- 台北出發・五人座：單程 $6,500、來回 $12,000
- 台北出發・九人座：單程 $8,000、來回 $15,000
- 台中出發・五人座：單程 $6,000、來回 $11,000
- 台中出發・九人座：單程 $7,500、來回 $14,000

**台北到玉山登山口怎麼去？**
玉山主峰從南投信義的塔塔加上山。台北到塔塔加約 4.5–5 小時；台21線新中橫草坪頭到塔塔加每天 17:30 到隔天 07:00 封閉，清晨要到塔塔加只能走台18線阿里山公路。 一般車輛只能到塔塔加遊客中心和上東埔停車場一帶，過了塔塔加管制站，自用車不能再往上開。從上東埔的排雲登山服務中心到玉山登山口約 2.5 公里，可以走路（約 40–50 分鐘）或搭付費接駁車。 沒有車的話，山行接駁從台北車站或指定地址出發，送到塔塔加可通行的區域，下山再接回。大眾運輸可以搭員林客運 6739 到上東埔，但一天只有幾班，大多在上午 10 點以後。

**台北、台中到玉山包車多少錢？**
整車計價，不是按人頭。台北出發：五人座單程 $6,500、來回 $12,000；九人座單程 $8,000、來回 $15,000。台中出發：五人座單程 $6,000、來回 $11,000；九人座單程 $7,500、來回 $14,000。五人座最多 4 位乘客，九人座最多 8 位乘客；來回是去程、回程各一趟。

**凌晨出發或下山比較晚，要另外加錢嗎？**
網站上的價格是指定出發地、車型和走法的整車參考費用，沒有另外列出固定的清晨加價或等候費金額。實際報價會依上車地點、接送時間、停靠需求和行程天數確認。 等候時間、可能產生的額外費用和緊急聯絡方式，都會在預約時先確認；所有額外費用會在預約成立前列明。

**可以直接送到玉山登山口嗎？**
接送以塔塔加可通行的區域為準。塔塔加到玉山登山口之間是管制路段，需要搭當地接駁或步行，出發前請先確認最新的管制方式。

**去玉山，車子會在哪裡讓你下車？**
一般車輛只能到塔塔加遊客中心和上東埔停車場一帶。過了塔塔加管制站，自用車不能再往上開。從上東埔的排雲登山服務中心到玉山登山口約 2.5 公里，可以走路（約 40–50 分鐘）或搭付費接駁車（官方公布每人每趟 150 元）。

**可以搭大眾運輸到塔塔加嗎？**
可以，員林客運 6739（日月潭－阿里山）會經過塔塔加，在上東埔下車就是排雲登山服務中心。但一天只有幾班，大多在上午 10 點以後，趕不上清晨出發的單日往返。

**從台北出發，幾點要離開才趕得上玉山的行程？**
台北到塔塔加約 4.5–5 小時。台21線新中橫的草坪頭到塔塔加每天 17:30 到隔天 07:00 封閉，所以清晨要到塔塔加只能走台18線阿里山公路。單日往返通常天亮前就要從登山口出發，所以要嘛半夜從台北出發，要嘛前一晚先住在附近。

**爬玉山要申請哪些許可？**
要申請玉山國家公園入園（排雲山莊床位、單日往返都要抽籤，約入園前 1 個月抽）和入山證（免費，入園核准後申請）。都在「臺灣登山申請一站式服務網」辦理，受理期間是入園日前 2 個月到 5 天。

### 雪山主東峰・武陵四秀登山接駁：走進雪山圈谷

網址：https://gohike.tw/routes/xueshan/

- 登山口／接送點：武陵農場（台中和平）
- 台北車程：約 3.5 小時
- 海拔：3,886 m
- 行程類型：兩天、三天

景觀：雪山圈谷、黑森林與高山稜線；武陵四秀則擁有不同山峰地形與展望。
適合客群：具高山登山經驗、希望安排兩天以上行程，欣賞高山地形與森林景觀的山友。
交通與注意事項：主要接送至武陵農場相關登山區域；部分時期涉及入園及車輛通行管制，需提前確認實際可到達的集合點。

價格（整車，新台幣）：
- 台北出發・五人座：單程 $5,500、來回 $11,000、一天來回 $9,000
- 台北出發・九人座：單程 $7,000、來回 $14,000、一天來回 $12,000
- 台中出發・五人座：單程 $6,500、來回 $13,000、一天來回 $12,000
- 台中出發・九人座：單程 $7,500、來回 $15,000、一天來回 $13,000

**台北到雪山登山口怎麼去？**
雪山登山口在台中和平的武陵農場裡。台北開車走國5 → 宜蘭 → 台7 → 棲蘭 → 台7甲到武陵農場，武陵農場公布約 3.5 小時。進農場要在收費站買門票（全票 160 元、小客車 50 元，只收現金），平常小客車可以開到雪山登山口停車場或武陵山莊停車場。 沒有車的話，山行接駁從台北車站或指定地址出發，送到武陵農場的雪山登山口一帶，下山時在約好的時間接回；實際可以到達的上下車點會在出發前和你確認。 大眾運輸是從宜蘭搭國光客運 1751、從羅東搭 1764 到武陵，約 2 小時 40 分，一天只有兩三班；到收費站要先下車買票，從農場到雪山登山口還有一段路。

**台北、台中到雪山登山口包車多少錢？**
整車計價，不是按人頭。台北出發：五人座單程 $5,500、來回 $11,000、一天來回 $9,000；九人座單程 $7,000、來回 $14,000、一天來回 $12,000。台中出發：五人座單程 $6,500、來回 $13,000、一天來回 $12,000；九人座單程 $7,500、來回 $15,000、一天來回 $13,000。 五人座最多 4 位乘客，九人座最多 8 位乘客。來回是去程、回程各一趟，例如兩天的主峰行程；一天來回是當天送上山、等下山再載回，例如東峰單日來回。

**凌晨出發或下山比較晚，要另外加錢嗎？**
網站上的價格是指定出發地、車型和走法的整車參考費用，沒有另外列出固定的清晨加價或等候費金額。實際報價會依上車地點、接送時間、停靠需求和行程天數確認。 等候時間、可能產生的額外費用和緊急聯絡方式，都會在預約時先確認；所有額外費用會在預約成立前列明。

**遇到封山、櫻花季管制或下雪怎麼辦？**
出發三日前通知，可全額退費取消或改期；遇封山或官方管制，可於出發前一日取消。 每年 2 月櫻花季武陵農場會管制車輛：多日行程的車要在入園前 3 天向雪霸登記，單日行程的隊伍不發車輛通行證。冬天台7甲南山到勝光常要加掛雪鏈或預防性封路。出發前我們會確認路況；車子到不了原定地點時，會和你討論替代集合點、調整時間或改期。

**車子可以開到雪山登山口嗎？**
主要接送到武陵農場相關的登山區域。部分時期武陵農場有入園及車輛通行管制，實際可以到達的集合點會在出發前和你確認。

**去雪山，車子可以開到登山口嗎？**
平常可以。買完武陵農場門票後，小客車可以開到雪山登山口停車場或武陵山莊停車場；大客車到不了登山口。2 月櫻花季有車輛管制，多日行程的車要事先向雪霸登記，單日行程的車不發通行證。

**從台北出發，幾點要離開才趕得上雪山的行程？**
台北到武陵農場約 3.5 小時（國5 經宜蘭、台7甲）。主峰兩天行程第一天要走到七卡山莊或三六九，通常一早就要從登山口出發；東峰單日來回也建議一早上山。冬天台7甲可能要加掛雪鏈或封路，要預留時間。

**可以搭大眾運輸去武陵農場嗎？**
可以搭國光客運 1751（宜蘭發車）或 1764（羅東發車），約 2 小時 40 分，一天只有兩三班。到收費站要先下車買門票，從農場到雪山登山口還有一段路。

**爬雪山要申請哪些許可？**
要申請雪霸國家公園入園和入山證，入園在入園日前 2 個月到 5 天受理，七卡山莊、三六九的床位跟著入園申請一起排。雪季（約 1 月初到 3 月底）另有雪地能力和裝備的規定。

### 合歡山群峰登山接駁：高山草原、雲海與群峰

網址：https://gohike.tw/routes/hehuan/

- 登山口／接送點：武嶺・昆陽・小風口（南投仁愛）
- 台北車程：約 4 小時
- 海拔：3,417 m
- 行程類型：當日來回、兩天

景觀：合歡山以開闊的高山草原、稜線和雲海聞名，可以依路線欣賞不同方向的山景。
適合客群：第一次體驗台灣高山健行的海外旅客、好友登山團，以及希望依能力選擇不同路線的山友。
交通與注意事項：可依行程安排武嶺、昆陽、小風口等不同集合地點。高海拔路段容易受到濃霧、低溫及道路管制影響。

價格（整車，新台幣）：
- 台北出發・五人座：單程 $6,000、來回 $12,000
- 台北出發・九人座：單程 $7,000、來回 $14,000
- 台中出發・五人座：單程 $5,000、來回 $10,000
- 台中出發・九人座：單程 $6,000、來回 $12,000

**台中到合歡山怎麼去？**
合歡山在南投仁愛的台14甲沿線，要爬哪一座決定在哪下車：主峰在武嶺或昆陽下車，北峰在小風口，東峰和石門山在松雪樓、合歡山莊一帶上山。 包車：山行接駁從台中高鐵站或指定地址出發，送到你要爬的那座山附近的停車點，下山後接回。 公車：南投客運有台中干城站、高鐵台中站發車，在埔里換線到清境農場的班車；到清境農場國民賓館再轉 6658A，往武嶺、松雪樓、小風口。6658A 要上網預約，天候不佳可能停駛，時刻與預約規則請看南投客運的最新公告。

**沒有車可以去合歡山嗎？**
可以，搭公車或包車都行。 從台北搭公車：先搭高鐵到台中，從高鐵台中站搭南投客運到埔里、清境農場，再轉 6658A 上合歡山。依南投客運目前的時刻表，6658A 一天三班，最早一班約 9 點到武嶺，最後一班回程 15:50 從小風口發車，所以趕不上日出，單日能走的時間也有限。6658A 是中型巴士，車上沒有放行李的地方，每次訂位最多 4 人。 包車：上車時間和下車地點依你的行程安排，台北出發約 4 小時，整車計價。

**台北、台中到合歡山包車多少錢？**
整車計價，不是按人頭。台北出發：五人座單程 $6,000、來回 $12,000；九人座單程 $7,000、來回 $14,000。台中出發：五人座單程 $5,000、來回 $10,000；九人座單程 $6,000、來回 $12,000。 五人座最多 4 位乘客，九人座最多 8 位乘客。收費表上沒有列的走法（例如當天上下山）請直接詢價。

**凌晨出發或下山比較晚，要另外加錢嗎？**
網站上的價格是指定出發地、車型和走法的整車參考費用，沒有另外列出固定的清晨加價或等候費金額。實際報價會依上車地點、接送時間、停靠需求和行程天數確認。 等候時間、可能產生的額外費用和緊急聯絡方式，都會在預約時先確認；所有額外費用會在預約成立前列明。

**遇到道路管制、下雪或高乘載怎麼辦？**
台14甲降雪結冰時，部分路段只開放加掛雪鏈的小客車，結冰的夜裡可能 17:00 到隔天 07:00 預防性封路。2026 年 10 月 24 日起，連續 3 天以上的假日 00:00–08:00，翠峰到大禹嶺的小客車要 3 人以上。 出發前我們會確認路況，遇到管制時會和你討論改到其他集合點或改期；遇封山或官方管制，可於出發前一日取消。

**合歡山遇到濃霧或道路管制怎麼辦？**
合歡山高海拔路段容易起濃霧、低溫，冬季也可能有道路管制。出發前我們會確認路況；遇到管制時，會和你討論改到其他集合點或改期。

**去合歡主峰，車子會停在哪裡？**
合歡主峰登山口在台14甲約 29.5K，登山口旁沒有停車位，一般在武嶺下車（走約 10 分鐘）或昆陽。北峰從小風口走約 600 公尺到登山口；東峰、石門山從松雪樓、合歡山莊一帶上山。

**爬合歡山需要申請入山證或入園證嗎？**
合歡主峰、東峰、北峰、西峰、石門山目前都不用。2020 年起合歡山區不在生態保護區，仁愛鄉也解除山地管制。要在山區露營才需要另外向太魯閣國家公園申請。

**合歡山連假有高乘載管制嗎？**
有。2026 年 10 月 24 日起，連續 3 天以上的假日 00:00–08:00，台14甲翠峰到大禹嶺的小客車要 3 人以上；春天杜鵑季假日也有。出發前請看公路局最新公告。

**冬天去合歡山要注意什麼？**
降雪結冰時，機車、大客車和 3.5 噸以上貨車禁止通行，部分路段只開放加掛雪鏈的小客車，結冰的夜裡也可能預防性封路。冬天出發前要先看公路局的路況，行程最好保留彈性。

### 大霸尖山登山接駁：欣賞台灣最有辨識度的山形

網址：https://gohike.tw/routes/dabajian/

- 登山口／接送點：觀霧・大鹿林道（新竹五峰）
- 台北車程：約 3.5 小時
- 海拔：3,492 m
- 行程類型：三天

景觀：大霸尖山特殊的桶狀山形與聖稜線風景，是台灣代表性的高山景觀。
適合客群：有多日登山及長距離步行經驗，希望挑戰進階高山路線的山友。
交通與注意事項：以觀霧、大鹿林道相關合法接送點為主；登山行程可能包含較長林道步行，需要預先評估接駁及步行時間。

價格（整車，新台幣）：
- 台北出發・五人座：單程 $6,000、來回 $12,000
- 台北出發・九人座：單程 $7,000、來回 $14,000
- 台中出發・五人座：單程 $6,000、來回 $12,000
- 台中出發・九人座：單程 $7,000、來回 $14,000

**大鹿林道可以開車進去嗎？**
接送以觀霧、大鹿林道相關的合法接送點為主。行程可能包含一段較長的林道步行，安排下山接送時間時請把林道步行時間算進去。

**去大霸尖山，車子可以開進大鹿林道嗎？**
不行。大鹿林道東線 0.4K 有管制站，一般車輛不能進入。車子停在觀霧，從觀霧走約 19 公里林道到馬達拉溪登山口（約 7 小時），再爬約 4 公里到九九山莊。

**爬大霸尖山要申請哪些許可？**
要申請雪霸國家公園入園（入園日前 2 個月到 5 天），九九山莊床位另外在新竹分署的系統申請。九九山莊整修到 2028 年底，期間每天只有 70 床。大霸尖山主峰禁止攀登，只到霸基。

**從台北出發，幾點要離開才趕得上大霸的行程？**
台北到觀霧約 3.5 小時。第一天光是林道就要走約 7 小時，再爬到九九山莊，所以通常清晨就要從觀霧出發。

### 南湖大山登山接駁：深入中央山脈高山圈谷

網址：https://gohike.tw/routes/nanhu/

- 登山口／接送點：勝光（台中和平）
- 台北車程：約 3 小時
- 海拔：3,742 m
- 行程類型：三天以上

景觀：南湖圈谷、冰河地形與壯闊山岳景觀，是台灣具有代表性的高山長程路線。
適合客群：體能及高山經驗較充足、希望安排三天以上登山行程的山友。
交通與注意事項：主要以勝光登山口周邊為接送起點；需考慮多日登山的上下山時間與天候，並確認管制與最新開放情形。

價格（整車，新台幣）：
- 台北出發・五人座：單程 $5,500、來回 $11,000
- 台北出發・九人座：單程 $7,000、來回 $14,000
- 台中出發・五人座：單程 $6,500、來回 $13,000
- 台中出發・九人座：單程 $7,500、來回 $15,000

**南湖大山這種多日行程，回程怎麼約？**
出發前先約好預計下山的日期和時間，我們在勝光登山口周邊等你。多日行程容易受天候影響，下山時間有變動請盡早在有訊號的地方通知我們。

**去南湖大山，車子會在哪裡讓你下車？**
現在多數人從勝光登山口上山，登山口在台7甲線勝光派出所旁，車停在路肩，旁邊是私人農地不要亂停。舊的思源埡口登山口（710 林道）坍方多，比較少人走。

**爬南湖大山要申請哪些許可？**
要申請太魯閣國家公園入園（生態保護區）和入山證。入園先到先審、不抽籤，入園日前 2 個月到 5 天受理，南湖大山線每天 60 人；雲稜、審馬陣、南湖山屋跟著入園申請一起排。

**從台北出發，幾點要離開才趕得上南湖的行程？**
台北到勝光約 3 小時。多日行程常在清晨 4、5 點從登山口出發，從台北要半夜出發才趕得上，也可以前一晚先住在附近。冬天台7甲可能要雪鏈或封路，要預留時間。

### 奇萊南華登山接駁：高山草原與開闊山稜

網址：https://gohike.tw/routes/qilai/

- 登山口／接送點：雲天宮登山口（南投仁愛）
- 台北車程：約 4.5 小時
- 海拔：3,358 m
- 行程類型：兩天

景觀：奇萊南峰與南華山一帶有大片高山草坡、稜線及雲海景觀。
適合客群：具備一定健行體能、想從中長程健行逐步挑戰百岳的山友。
交通與注意事項：2026 年起登山口改為雲天宮，原本的屯原 0–3K 因坍方封閉。通往雲天宮的路況較差，需留意能高越嶺道是否開放；建議以兩日以上行程規劃。

價格（整車，新台幣）：
- 台北出發・五人座：單程 $6,000、來回 $12,000
- 台北出發・九人座：單程 $7,000、來回 $14,000
- 台中出發・五人座：單程 $5,000、來回 $10,000
- 台中出發・九人座：單程 $6,000、來回 $12,000

**奇萊南華的登山口路況需要先確認嗎？**
需要。能高越嶺道和通往登山口的道路偶爾會因路況封閉，我們會在出發前確認實際可以到達的位置。

**奇萊南華現在從哪個登山口上山？**
2026 年 1 月 1 日起改從雲天宮登山口進出，屯原 0–3K 因坍方封閉，屯原服務站也搬到雲天宮。從雲天宮起登比原本多爬約 350 公尺、多花 1.5–2 小時。

**車子到得了雲天宮登山口嗎？**
官方資料寫小客車可以到，但從台14線約 99K 進去的路面顛簸、路況差，官方建議高底盤車或接駁車，而且要停在指定停車場。出發前請先確認最新路況。

**爬奇萊南峰、南華山要申請什麼？**
天池山莊床位或營位要在住宿日前 60 天到 5 天申請，30 天前抽籤。奇萊南峰在太魯閣國家公園內要申請入園，南華山不用。2020 年起不用入山證。

### 嘉明湖登山接駁：走進高山中的藍色湖泊

網址：https://gohike.tw/routes/jiaming/

- 登山口／接送點：向陽（台東海端）
- 台北車程：約 7–8 小時
- 海拔：3,310 m
- 行程類型：三天

景觀：嘉明湖以高山湖泊景觀聞名，沿途可以欣賞森林、草坡及高山稜線。
適合客群：喜歡高山自然景觀、能負擔多日長距離步行的登山團體。
交通與注意事項：登山口位於台東向陽地區，台北出發約需 7–8 小時。從海外來的旅客請預留足夠的交通與休息時間。

價格（整車，新台幣）：
- 台北出發・五人座：單程 $8,000、來回 $16,000
- 台北出發・九人座：單程 $10,000、來回 $20,000
- 台中出發・五人座：單程 $8,000、來回 $16,000
- 台中出發・九人座：單程 $10,000、來回 $20,000

**從台北到嘉明湖登山口要開多久？**
向陽登山口在台東，台北出發約 7–8 小時。如果是剛抵達台灣，建議先休息一晚再出發，或把車程排進行程的第一天。

**去嘉明湖，車子會在哪裡讓你下車？**
向陽國家森林遊樂區，在台20線南橫 154.5K。遊樂區目前休園施工，只當作步道進出的通道，園區內不能停車。從向陽登山服務站走 4.3 公里到向陽山屋，13 公里到嘉明湖。

**南橫公路有交通管制嗎？會影響去嘉明湖嗎？**
南橫西段（高雄梅山口到向陽）週二到週四封閉，其他日子 07:00–14:00 進、17:00 前出。從台東池上、海端上來到向陽不經過這段。出發前請看公路局最新公告。

**爬嘉明湖要申請哪些許可？**
要申請山屋或營位（住宿日前 60 天到 5 天，30 天前抽籤）和入山證。嘉明湖不在國家公園內，不用入園。單日往返要另外申請，每隊最多 10 人，最早 03:00 出發、17:00 前下山。

### 松蘿湖登山接駁：森林深處的夢幻湖泊

網址：https://gohike.tw/routes/songluo/

- 登山口／接送點：松蘿湖登山口（宜蘭大同）
- 台北車程：約 2 小時
- 海拔：1,300 m
- 行程類型：當日來回、兩天

景觀：山林環繞的湖泊與水面倒影，雨霧天氣別有森林湖景氛圍。
適合客群：喜歡森林、湖泊及露營景觀，具備泥濘山徑健行經驗的旅客。
交通與注意事項：位於宜蘭大同一帶，台北出發車程約 2 小時。登山口最後路段與天候須確認，潮濕時山徑容易泥濘。

價格（整車，新台幣）：
- 台北出發・五人座：單程 $5,000、來回 $10,000
- 台北出發・九人座：單程 $6,000、來回 $12,000
- 台中出發・五人座：單程 $6,000、來回 $12,000
- 台中出發・九人座：單程 $7,000、來回 $14,000

**下雨天還能去松蘿湖嗎？**
登山口最後一段路和山徑都受天候影響，潮濕時山徑容易泥濘。出發前我們會確認登山口路況，天候不佳時建議改期。

**松蘿湖的登山口在哪裡？車子到得了嗎？**
登山口在宜蘭大同玉蘭茶園產業道路的盡頭（大水塔旁），從台7線約 100K 轉本覺路上山。導航有時會帶到夏諾營方向，容易卡車。登山口只能停 6、7 台車。

**去松蘿湖需要入山證嗎？**
需要。松蘿湖在山地管制區，可以線上申請入山證，也可以當天到台7線約 102K 的大同分駐所辦理。

**松蘿湖要走多久？**
單程 5.4 公里，原路來回。輕裝來回約 7 小時，重裝上山約 4–5 小時。山徑非常泥濘，建議穿雨鞋。

### 加里山登山接駁：苗栗代表性的中級山

網址：https://gohike.tw/routes/jiali/

- 登山口／接送點：鹿場（苗栗南庄）
- 台北車程：約 2.5 小時
- 海拔：2,220 m
- 行程類型：當日來回

景觀：柳杉林、山徑岩石地形與山頂展望，沿途充滿中級山森林特色。
適合客群：喜歡森林健行、具備一定體能與基礎攀爬能力的山友。
交通與注意事項：主要以苗栗南庄鹿場周邊登山口接送；山區道路較狹窄，應事先確認上車點及回程時間。

價格（整車，新台幣）：
- 依行程報價，歡迎詢價

**加里山的接駁要事先確認什麼？**
鹿場一帶山區道路較狹窄，請事先和我們確認上車點和預計下山時間，回程才不會等太久。

**加里山從哪個登山口上山？**
最常走的是鹿場登山口（南庄鹿場部落，加里山民宿後方），來回 6.8 公里、約 7–9 小時；也可以從大坪登山口走 9.6 公里的環線。甲、乙類大客車不能進入。

**爬加里山需要申請入山證嗎？**
不用。加里山不需要入山申請，可以直接去爬。

### 羅馬縱走登山接駁：穿越森林與稜線的縱走體驗

網址：https://gohike.tw/routes/luoma/

- 登山口／接送點：思源埡口・馬鰣橋（台7甲線）
- 行程類型：單日縱走

景觀：羅葉尾山與馬武佐野郡山一帶的森林、稜線與自然景觀。
適合客群：有中級山縱走經驗、希望安排整天長距離健行的山友。
交通與注意事項：須先確認縱走方向、起點與終點；不同進出點可能影響車輛調度及價格。

價格（整車，新台幣）：
- 台北出發・五人座：單程 $5,500、來回 $11,000、一天來回 $9,000
- 台北出發・九人座：單程 $7,000、來回 $14,000、一天來回 $12,000
- 台中出發・五人座：單程 $6,000、來回 $12,000、一天來回 $10,000
- 台中出發・九人座：單程 $7,000、來回 $14,000、一天來回 $12,000

**縱走起點和終點不同，接駁怎麼安排？**
我們送你到起點，再到終點接你下山，你不用回原點取車。詢價時請寫下縱走方向，不同的進出點會影響車輛調度和價格。

**羅馬縱走的起點和終點在哪裡？**
常見是從思源埡口舊派出所（台7甲約 45.6K）進，走到馬鰣橋（台7甲約 50.6K，勝光附近）出，兩端公路距離約 5 公里。全程約 10–12 公里、8–9 小時。

**羅馬縱走可以搭公車嗎？**
國光客運 1751、1764 會到思源，但回程末班車約下午 2 點半，走完單日縱走通常趕不上，要另外安排交通。

### 高島縱走登山接駁：走進柳杉林與中級山稜線

網址：https://gohike.tw/routes/gaodao/

- 登山口／接送點：高台山及相應出入口
- 行程類型：當日來回

景觀：高台山至島田山系一帶的杉木林、稜線與起伏山徑。
適合客群：適合具有登山經驗、想挑戰較長時間森林縱走的旅客。
交通與注意事項：應確認高台山及相應出入口的實際位置，並預先安排下山接送時間。

價格（整車，新台幣）：
- 台北出發・五人座：一天來回 $6,500
- 台北出發・九人座：一天來回 $8,000
- 台中出發・五人座：一天來回 $6,500
- 台中出發・九人座：一天來回 $8,000

**高島縱走要在哪裡上下車？**
會依你的走法確認實際的登山口位置，出發前一起約好下山接送的時間與地點。

**高島縱走在哪裡？要從哪裡上山？**
在新竹尖石那羅部落一帶，走竹60線過柿山大橋，跟著「高台山露營區」指標。多數人從第一登山口上山，同一個登山口進出，約 9–10 公里、6–8 小時。

**高島縱走要帶多少水？**
全程沒有水源，一般建議帶 2–3 公升。下午常起霧，最好早點出發。

### 塔曼山登山接駁：北台灣的高山森林漫步

網址：https://gohike.tw/routes/taman/

- 登山口／接送點：拉拉山地區登山口（桃園復興）
- 海拔：2,130 m
- 行程類型：當日來回

景觀：原始森林、苔蘚、樹根交錯的山徑以及潮濕森林生態。
適合客群：喜歡森林攝影、自然觀察，且能適應濕滑山徑的健行旅客。
交通與注意事項：多由拉拉山地區相關登山口進出，需提前確認車輛可抵達位置及當地道路狀況。

價格（整車，新台幣）：
- 台北出發・五人座：一天來回 $6,500
- 台北出發・九人座：一天來回 $8,000
- 台中出發・五人座：一天來回 $7,500
- 台中出發・九人座：一天來回 $8,000

**塔曼山的登山口車子到得了嗎？**
塔曼山多由拉拉山地區的登山口進出，我們會在出發前確認車輛可以抵達的位置和當地道路狀況。

**塔曼山從哪裡上山？**
從大水塔登山口上山：台7 → 拉拉山 → 上巴陵 → 雲頂露營區，再依指標。單程 3 公里，上山約 3 小時、下山約 2 小時。登山口附近只能停 3–5 台車，中、大型巴士進不去。

**爬塔曼山需要申請入山證嗎？**
不用。但山頂再往後是插天山自然保留區，未經許可進入會被罰款，請在山頂折返。

### 北得拉曼登山接駁：巨木森林與山徑挑戰

網址：https://gohike.tw/routes/beidelaman/

- 登山口／接送點：水田部落（新竹尖石）
- 行程類型：當日來回

景觀：巨木群、森林生態與中級山山徑，是新竹山區具有特色的健行目的地。
適合客群：已有基礎山徑經驗、喜歡巨木森林及較有挑戰性的登山客。
交通與注意事項：山區道路及最後登山口位置應於出發前確認；回程須預留足夠下山與行車時間。

價格（整車，新台幣）：
- 台北出發・五人座：一天來回 $6,500
- 台北出發・九人座：一天來回 $8,000
- 台中出發・五人座：一天來回 $7,000
- 台中出發・九人座：一天來回 $9,000

**北得拉曼回程要預留多少時間？**
新竹山區道路彎多，下山後到市區還有一段車程。約回程時間時，請預留足夠的下山與行車時間，我們會依你的行程建議出發時間。

**北得拉曼的登山口在哪裡？**
在新竹尖石水田部落上方的水田林道登山口：竹120往新樂，轉水田林道（竹58）。小客車可以到，中、大型巴士不行；週末早上 7 點前停車位常常就滿了。

**爬北得拉曼需要入山證嗎？**
不用申請入山。來回約 6 小時，步道上沒有廁所。

### 郡大山登山接駁：欣賞中央山脈高山稜線

網址：https://gohike.tw/routes/junda/

- 登山口／接送點：郡大林道（南投信義）
- 海拔：3,265 m
- 行程類型：單日百岳

景觀：郡大山一帶以高山稜線、箭竹草坡及山岳景觀為主要特色。
適合客群：有中高海拔登山經驗、希望安排單日百岳行程的登山者。
交通與注意事項：郡大林道可能有路況、交通管制、車型及可通行範圍的限制。目前只提供九人座的價格；實際載運的車輛、最後能到達的位置，以及是否需要另外安排林道交通，都會在報價時說清楚，不代表一般車輛一定能直達登山口。

價格（整車，新台幣）：
- 台北出發・九人座：來回 $18,000、一天來回 $16,000
- 台中出發・九人座：來回 $15,000、一天來回 $13,000

**車子可以直接開到郡大山登山口嗎？**
不一定。郡大林道有路況、交通管制和車型限制，最後能到達的位置要看當時狀況。報價時我們會說明實際載運的車輛、可以到達的地點，以及是否需要另外安排林道交通。

**郡大林道現在可以開車進去嗎？**
林道由南投分署管理，郡大山登山口在約 32K，官方建議開高底盤四輪傳動車。林道常因施工調整通行時間或暫時封閉，出發前請看南投分署的林道狀況頁。

### 霞喀羅古道（A 進 B 出）登山接駁：一次走訪山林古道

網址：https://gohike.tw/routes/xiakaluo-ab/

- 登山口／接送點：養老・石鹿（新竹尖石、五峰）
- 行程類型：當日來回

景觀：歷史古道、山林景觀、溪谷與季節性變化，秋季部分區段具有賞楓特色。
適合客群：喜歡古道文化、森林健行，並且已有較長距離步行經驗的團體。
交通與注意事項：A 進 B 出最大的好處，是不必回到原本的起點取車。我們會配合安排不同的起點與終點，實際集合地點與接送範圍會在報價時列清楚。

價格（整車，新台幣）：
- 台北出發・九人座：來回 $14,000、一天來回 $10,000
- 台中出發・九人座：來回 $14,000、一天來回 $10,000

**A 進 B 出是怎麼接送？**
我們送你到古道的一端，你走完全程後，車在另一端等你，不用走回頭路取車。實際的集合地點與接送範圍會在報價時列清楚。

**霞喀羅古道兩端的登山口在哪裡？**
石鹿端（0K）在新竹五峰，走竹122到清泉，再上清石產業道路約 45 分鐘；養老端在新竹尖石，走竹60往秀巒。全長約 22 公里，官方估計約 10 小時。

**霞喀羅古道現在可以全線走通嗎？**
要看當時公告。養老端 21K 附近近年多次坍方封閉，2026 年 16.2K 的棧橋也被落石砸毀。出發前請看林業及自然保育署新竹分署的步道公告。

**走霞喀羅古道需要入山證嗎？**
不用申請入山。兩端都沒有大眾運輸，中、大型巴士也不能進入。

### 霞喀羅古道（養老進出）登山接駁：漫步歷史古道與山林

網址：https://gohike.tw/routes/xiakaluo-yanglao/

- 登山口／接送點：養老（新竹尖石）
- 行程類型：當日來回

景觀：同樣以森林與歷史步道景觀為核心，但可依預定折返點選擇不同的健行長度。
適合客群：想體驗古道景觀，但未計畫完整 A 進 B 出的山友。
交通與注意事項：養老進出通常在同一個集合區域上下車，和異地縱走接駁不同。會依當時道路開放情形確認養老端可以到達的位置。

價格（整車，新台幣）：
- 台北出發・九人座：一天來回 $8,000
- 台中出發・九人座：一天來回 $8,000

**養老進出和 A 進 B 出差在哪？**
養老進出是從同一端上山、原路折返，在同一個地點上下車；A 進 B 出則是從一端進、另一端出，需要兩個接送點。

**從養老端走霞喀羅古道，要注意什麼？**
養老端 21K 附近近年多次坍方封閉，出發前請先看林業及自然保育署新竹分署的公告。走霞喀羅不用申請入山，但沒有大眾運輸，中、大型巴士也不能進入。

## In English

### Questions

**How do I book a shuttle?**
Send us your route, start and return dates, number of passengers, pick-up place and time. We confirm the trip and vehicle, then send a quote. The booking is confirmed once we both agree the price and pick-up details and the agreed deposit is paid.

**Do I need to pay a deposit?**
Yes. Once the vehicle and trip are confirmed, we send a formal quote with deposit details. The deposit amount and when and how to pay the balance are all agreed before you book. The car is held for you once the deposit is paid.

**How can I pay?**
The deposit can be paid by bank transfer or LINE Pay, and overseas visitors can use PayPal. The balance is paid in New Taiwan dollars, in cash or by bank transfer. We send payment details and deadlines with your quote. If you are overseas, tell us where you will pay from and we confirm the best method.

**What if I need to cancel or change dates?**
Tell us at least three days before departure for a full refund or a new date. If the mountain or road is closed by the authorities, you can cancel up to one day before.

**Is the website price the final price?**
Website prices are reference prices for the whole vehicle, by starting city, vehicle and trip type. Your quote depends on the pick-up place, times, extra stops, number of days and road conditions. Any extra cost is listed before you book, and the trip confirmation lists anything not included, such as private trailhead, park entry or parking fees.

**What does the price include, and what do I arrange myself?**
The price covers the whole vehicle for the drive from your pick-up place to the trailhead, or from the trailhead back to the city. The 5-seat car takes up to 4 passengers and the 9-seat van up to 8. Other costs, such as private trailhead, park entry or parking fees, are not in the website price; they are listed on your trip confirmation. Park and mountain permits, cabins or campsites, hiking insurance and gear are yours to arrange. We can share where to apply when you ask for a quote.

**How is the price worked out?**
You pay per vehicle. We have a 5-seat car and a 9-seat van, starting from Taipei or Taichung. One way starts at NT$5,000, and each route's price is in the price table above. For trips with no price in the table, or trailheads not listed, send us your destination, date and group size and we reply with a clear price.

**Does the driver speak English?**
Our driver speaks some basic English, enough for pick-up times and places. For details, message us in English on WhatsApp, LINE or email, and we confirm everything in writing before the trip.

**What is the difference between one way, round trip and same-day return?**
One way: from the city to the trailhead, or from the trailhead back to the city. Round trip: two drives, there and back, on the dates we agree, written on your trip confirmation. Same-day return: we drop you at the trailhead and pick you up at the agreed time the same day.

**Will the driver wait if we come down late?**
Before you start hiking, we confirm the pick-up time and place again, and the driver waits at the agreed time. We know hikes can run long because of fitness, weather or trail conditions. Please update us on your expected finish time during the hike if you can. Waiting time, any extra fees and emergency contacts are agreed when you book.

**Can I change the pick-up place or add a stop?**
If you want to leave from a hotel, home or another address, tell us when you ask for a quote. We check distance, route and vehicle schedule, and tell you any extra cost in advance. Last-minute changes depend on that day's roads and schedule.

**What if the road to the trailhead is closed?**
Mountain roads can close because of weather, roadworks, disasters or official restrictions. We check the latest road information and choose a legal, safe meeting point. If the car can't reach the original place, we discuss another meeting point, a different start time or a new date with you. If the trip can't go ahead at all, refunds follow the applicable rules and what we agreed.

**Can the 9-seat van really take 8 passengers and 8 big packs?**
The 9-seat van takes up to 8 passengers, but luggage space depends on the size and number of packs and the van's layout. If everyone has a large hiking pack, tell us the pack sizes and count when you ask for a quote, and we help choose the right vehicle and how to carry everything.

**What vehicles do you have, and how many people fit?**
Two types: the 5-seat car takes up to 4 passengers; the 9-seat van is a Volkswagen Caravelle or similar and takes up to 8 passengers. If you have a larger group or lots of big packs, tell us when you ask for a quote and we suggest a vehicle.

**Can you go to trailheads not listed on the website?**
Just ask. The website lists our most common routes. For other trailheads, choose "Other trailhead" in the form and write the place in the notes.

**Do I need to arrange park and mountain permits and cabins myself?**
Yes. We provide the transport. Park and mountain permits, cabins or campsites, hiking insurance and gear are arranged by you. We can share where to apply for permits and cabins when you ask for a quote.

**Can I book from Hong Kong, Malaysia or Singapore?**
Yes. The form accepts international numbers such as +852, +60 and +65, or you can leave just an email. Choose how you want us to contact you (WhatsApp, LINE or email). Please include your flight arrival date and preferred language, and we reply with a quote after confirming the vehicle and trip.

**How do overseas visitors pay?**
The deposit can be paid by PayPal, bank transfer or LINE Pay. The balance is paid in New Taiwan dollars, in cash or by bank transfer. Tell us where you will pay from when you ask for a quote, and we confirm the best method with your quote.

**How long is the drive from Taipei to the trailheads?**
It depends on the route: about 4 hours to Hehuanshan, 4.5 to 5 hours to Tataka for Yushan, and 7 to 8 hours to Xiangyang for Jiaming Lake. If you have just landed in Taiwan, allow enough time to travel and rest. Each route card shows the drive time.

**Do overseas visitors also need their own park and mountain permits?**
Yes. We provide the transport. Park and mountain permits, cabins or campsites, hiking insurance and gear are arranged by you. We can share where to apply when you ask for a quote. Applications are made at hike.taiwan.gov.tw.

## Routes in English

### Yushan / Jade Mountain (玉山) hiking shuttle: Taiwan's highest peak, 3,952 m

URL: https://gohike.tw/en/routes/yushan/

- Trailhead / drop-off: Tataka (塔塔加), Xinyi, Nantou
- Drive from Taipei: About 4.5–5 hours
- Altitude: 3,952 m
- Trip length: 2 days

Scenery: At 3,952 m, Yushan is Taiwan's highest peak. From the main summit you look out over the Central Range and the peaks around it.
Good for: Hikers with mid-to-high altitude experience who want to climb Taiwan's highest peak. A good fit for overseas groups taking on the Baiyue (百岳).
Getting there: About 4.5 to 5 hours from Taipei. Drop-off and pick-up are within the part of Tataka (塔塔加) open to vehicles. The road from Tataka to the Yushan trailhead is controlled and uses a local shuttle.

Prices (per vehicle, NT$):
- From Taipei, 5-seat: one way NT$6,500, round trip NT$12,000
- From Taipei, 9-seat: one way NT$8,000, round trip NT$15,000
- From Taichung, 5-seat: one way NT$6,000, round trip NT$11,000
- From Taichung, 9-seat: one way NT$7,500, round trip NT$14,000

**How do I get from Taipei to the Yushan trailhead?**
Yushan (Jade Mountain) is climbed from Tataka (塔塔加) in Xinyi, Nantou. Taipei to Tataka is about 4.5 to 5 hours. Highway 21 from Caopingtou to Tataka is closed every night from 17:30 to 07:00, so an early-morning arrival has to come via Highway 18 from Alishan. Regular vehicles can only go as far as Tataka Visitor Center and the Shangdongpu (上東埔) parking area; private cars cannot pass the Tataka checkpoint. From the Paiyun Hiking Service Center at Shangdongpu to the Yushan trailhead is about 2.5 km, a 40 to 50 minute walk, or take the paid local shuttle. Without a car, Go Hike (山行接駁) runs private hiking shuttles from Taipei Main Station or your address to the part of Tataka open to vehicles, and picks you up after the hike. By public transport, Yuanlin Bus 6739 stops at Shangdongpu, but there are only a few buses a day, mostly after 10 am.

**How much is a private shuttle from Taipei or Taichung to Yushan?**
Prices are per vehicle, not per person. From Taipei: 5-seat one way NT$6,500, round trip NT$12,000; 9-seat one way NT$8,000, round trip NT$15,000. From Taichung: 5-seat one way NT$6,000, round trip NT$11,000; 9-seat one way NT$7,500, round trip NT$14,000. The 5-seat car takes up to 4 passengers and the 9-seat van up to 8. Round trip is two drives, there and back.

**Is there an extra charge for an early start or for waiting?**
The prices on this site are per-vehicle reference prices for each departure city, vehicle and trip type. The site does not list a fixed early-morning surcharge or waiting fee. Your final quote depends on the pick-up place, times, stops and number of days. Waiting time, any possible extra cost and the emergency contact are agreed when you book, and any extra cost is listed before the booking is confirmed.

**Can you drive us right to the Yushan trailhead?**
We drop off and pick up within the part of Tataka (塔塔加) open to vehicles. The road from Tataka to the Yushan trailhead is controlled, so you take the local shuttle or walk. Please check the latest rules before you go.

**Where does the shuttle drop you for Yushan?**
Regular vehicles can only go as far as Tataka Visitor Center and the Shangdongpu (上東埔) parking area. Private cars cannot pass the Tataka checkpoint. From the Paiyun Hiking Service Center at Shangdongpu to the Yushan trailhead is about 2.5 km. You can walk it in 40 to 50 minutes or take the paid local shuttle (the park lists NT$150 per person per ride).

**Can I get to Tataka by public transport?**
Yes. Yuanlin Bus 6739 (Sun Moon Lake to Alishan) passes Tataka; get off at Shangdongpu for the Paiyun Hiking Service Center. There are only a few buses a day, mostly after 10 am, which is too late for a dawn start on the single-day route.

**How early do I need to leave Taipei for Yushan?**
Taipei to Tataka is about 4.5 to 5 hours. Highway 21 from Caopingtou to Tataka is closed every night from 17:30 to 07:00, so an early-morning arrival has to use Highway 18 via Alishan. Single-day hikers usually start before dawn, so you either leave Taipei in the middle of the night or stay nearby the night before.

**What permits do I need for Yushan?**
You need a Yushan National Park entry permit and a police mountain permit (入山證, free, applied for after the park permit is approved). Paiyun Lodge beds and the single-day route both go to a lottery about 1 month before. Apply on the Taiwan hiking permits portal, from 2 months to 5 days before your entry date.

### Xueshan / Snow Mountain & Wuling Four Peaks (雪山・武陵四秀) hiking shuttle: Glacial cirques and the Black Forest, 3,886 m

URL: https://gohike.tw/en/routes/xueshan/

- Trailhead / drop-off: Wuling Farm (武陵農場), Heping, Taichung
- Drive from Taipei: About 3.5 hours
- Altitude: 3,886 m
- Trip length: 2 days, 3 days

Scenery: The Xueshan glacial cirque, the Black Forest and high ridges. The Wuling Four Peaks (武陵四秀) add different summits and views.
Good for: Hikers with high-mountain experience planning two days or more, who want to see alpine landforms and forest.
Getting there: We mainly drop off and pick up in the hiking area of Wuling Farm (武陵農場). At some times of year there are entry and vehicle controls, so we confirm the meeting point you can actually reach in advance.

Prices (per vehicle, NT$):
- From Taipei, 5-seat: one way NT$5,500, round trip NT$11,000, same-day return NT$9,000
- From Taipei, 9-seat: one way NT$7,000, round trip NT$14,000, same-day return NT$12,000
- From Taichung, 5-seat: one way NT$6,500, round trip NT$13,000, same-day return NT$12,000
- From Taichung, 9-seat: one way NT$7,500, round trip NT$15,000, same-day return NT$13,000

**How do I get from Taipei to the Xueshan trailhead?**
The Xueshan (Snow Mountain) trailhead is inside Wuling Farm (武陵農場) in Heping, Taichung. By road from Taipei: Freeway 5, Yilan, Highway 7, Qilan, then Highway 7A to Wuling; Wuling Farm lists about 3.5 hours. Everyone pays at the farm gate (NT$160 per adult, NT$50 per car, cash only). Normally cars can drive on to the Xueshan trailhead lot or the Wuling Lodge lot. Without a car, Go Hike (山行接駁) drives you from Taipei Main Station or your address to the Xueshan trailhead area at Wuling Farm and picks you up at the agreed time. We confirm the exact drop-off point you can reach before the trip. By public transport, Kuo-Kuang bus 1751 (from Yilan) or 1764 (from Luodong) takes about 2 hours 40 minutes to Wuling, with only two or three buses a day. You get off at the gate to buy tickets, and there is still a stretch of road from the farm to the trailhead.

**How much is a private shuttle from Taipei or Taichung to Xueshan?**
Prices are per vehicle, not per person. From Taipei: 5-seat one way NT$5,500, round trip NT$11,000, same-day return NT$9,000; 9-seat one way NT$7,000, round trip NT$14,000, same-day return NT$12,000. From Taichung: 5-seat one way NT$6,500, round trip NT$13,000, same-day return NT$12,000; 9-seat one way NT$7,500, round trip NT$15,000, same-day return NT$13,000. The 5-seat car takes up to 4 passengers and the 9-seat van up to 8. Round trip is two drives, for example a 2-day main peak trip. Same-day return means we drop you off and pick you up the same day, for example an East Peak day hike.

**Is there an extra charge for an early start or for waiting?**
The prices on this site are per-vehicle reference prices for each departure city, vehicle and trip type. The site does not list a fixed early-morning surcharge or waiting fee. Your final quote depends on the pick-up place, times, stops and number of days. Waiting time, any possible extra cost and the emergency contact are agreed when you book, and any extra cost is listed before the booking is confirmed.

**What happens if the road or mountain is closed, or it snows?**
Tell us at least three days before departure for a full refund or a new date. If the mountain or road is closed by the authorities, you can cancel up to one day before. Vehicles are controlled at Wuling Farm during the February cherry blossom season: multi-day teams register their vehicle with Shei-Pa 3 days before entry, and single-day teams get no vehicle pass. In winter, Highway 7A from Nanshan to Shengguang often needs snow chains or closes as a precaution. We check road conditions before the trip, and if the car cannot reach the planned point, we discuss another meeting point, a different time or a new date with you.

**Can the car drive to the Xueshan trailhead?**
We mainly drop off and pick up in the hiking area of Wuling Farm (武陵農場). At some times of year the farm has entry and vehicle controls, so we confirm the exact meeting point with you before the trip.

**Can the car drive to the Xueshan trailhead?**
Normally yes. After paying at the Wuling Farm gate, cars can drive to the Xueshan trailhead lot or the Wuling Lodge lot. Large buses cannot reach the trailhead. During the February cherry blossom season, multi-day teams must register their vehicle with Shei-Pa in advance, and single-day teams get no vehicle pass.

**How early do I need to leave Taipei for Xueshan?**
Taipei to Wuling Farm is about 3.5 hours (Freeway 5 via Yilan and Highway 7A). On the 2-day main peak trip you need to reach Qika Cabin or 369 on day one, so you usually start from the trailhead early in the morning. An East Peak day hike also needs an early start. In winter Highway 7A may need chains or close, so leave extra time.

**Can I get to Wuling Farm by public transport?**
Yes. Kuo-Kuang bus 1751 (from Yilan) or 1764 (from Luodong) takes about 2 hours 40 minutes, with only two or three buses a day. You get off at the gate to buy tickets, and there is still a stretch of road from the farm to the Xueshan trailhead.

**What permits do I need for Xueshan?**
You need a Shei-Pa National Park entry permit and a police mountain permit. Park permits open 2 months before and close 5 days before entry, and Qika and 369 beds are booked with the park permit. In snow season (about early January to late March) there are extra rules on snow skills and gear.

### Hehuanshan peaks (合歡山) hiking shuttle: Alpine grassland, sea of clouds, easy 3,000 m summits

URL: https://gohike.tw/en/routes/hehuan/

- Trailhead / drop-off: Wuling Pass, Kunyang or Xiaofengkou (武嶺・昆陽・小風口), Nantou
- Drive from Taipei: About 4 hours
- Altitude: 3,417 m
- Trip length: Day trip, 2 days

Scenery: Hehuanshan is known for open alpine grassland, ridges and a sea of clouds, with mountain views in different directions depending on your route.
Good for: Overseas visitors on their first Taiwan high-mountain hike, groups of friends, and hikers who want a route that fits their level.
Getting there: We can meet you at Wuling Pass (武嶺), Kunyang (昆陽), Xiaofengkou (小風口) or other points, to fit your plan. The high road is often affected by thick fog, cold and road closures.

Prices (per vehicle, NT$):
- From Taipei, 5-seat: one way NT$6,000, round trip NT$12,000
- From Taipei, 9-seat: one way NT$7,000, round trip NT$14,000
- From Taichung, 5-seat: one way NT$5,000, round trip NT$10,000
- From Taichung, 9-seat: one way NT$6,000, round trip NT$12,000

**How do I get from Taipei to Hehuanshan without a car?**
There are two ways: a private shuttle, or high-speed rail plus buses. Private shuttle: Go Hike (山行接駁) picks you up at Taipei Main Station or your address and drives you to the parking point for the peak you are hiking, about 4 hours from Taipei, then picks you up after the hike. You choose the pick-up time. Public transport: take High Speed Rail to Taichung. From HSR Taichung Station (or Taichung Gancheng Station), Nantou Bus runs connecting services to Puli and on to Cingjing Farm (清境農場), changing route at Puli. At the Cingjing Farm Guest House stop (國民賓館), change to Nantou Bus 6658A to Wuling Pass (武嶺), Songxue Lodge (松雪樓) and Xiaofengkou (小風口).

**What are the limits of the Hehuanshan bus?**
Under the current Nantou Bus timetable, 6658A runs three times a day. The first bus reaches Wuling Pass a little after 9 am and the last bus back leaves Xiaofengkou at 15:50, so it does not work for sunrise or a long day hike. Seats are booked online, from 7 days before until noon the day before, up to 4 people per booking; without a booking you queue on the day. It is a mid-size bus with no luggage space, and it may not run in thick fog, heavy rain, snow or ice. Check the current timetable before you go. A private shuttle runs on your schedule and stops where your hike starts. It is priced per vehicle, not per seat.

**How do I get to Hehuanshan from Taichung?**
Hehuanshan is on Highway 14A in Ren-ai, Nantou. Where you get off depends on the peak: Wuling Pass or Kunyang for the Main Peak, Xiaofengkou for North Peak, and Songxue Lodge or Hehuan Villa for East Peak and Shimen Mountain. By private shuttle, Go Hike (山行接駁) picks you up at Taichung HSR Station or your address and drives you to that point. By bus, take Nantou Bus from Taichung via Puli to Cingjing Farm, then 6658A, as described above.

**How much is a private shuttle from Taipei or Taichung to Hehuanshan?**
Prices are per vehicle, not per person. From Taipei: 5-seat one way NT$6,000, round trip NT$12,000; 9-seat one way NT$7,000, round trip NT$14,000. From Taichung: 5-seat one way NT$5,000, round trip NT$10,000; 9-seat one way NT$6,000, round trip NT$12,000. The 5-seat car takes up to 4 passengers and the 9-seat van up to 8. For trip types not in the price table, such as up and down on the same day, ask us for a quote.

**Is there an extra charge for an early start or for waiting?**
The prices on this site are per-vehicle reference prices for each departure city, vehicle and trip type. The site does not list a fixed early-morning surcharge or waiting fee. Your final quote depends on the pick-up place, times, stops and number of days. Waiting time, any possible extra cost and the emergency contact are agreed when you book, and any extra cost is listed before the booking is confirmed.

**What about road closures, snow and the carpool rule?**
When there is snow or ice on Highway 14A, some stretches are open only to cars with snow chains, and on icy nights the road may close from 17:00 to 07:00. From October 24, 2026, on every holiday of 3 or more days, cars between Cuifeng and Dayuling need at least 3 people from 00:00 to 08:00. We check road conditions before the trip. If the road is controlled, we discuss another meeting point or a new date with you. If the mountain or road is closed by the authorities, you can cancel up to one day before.

**What happens if there is thick fog or a road closure at Hehuanshan?**
The high road at Hehuanshan often gets thick fog and cold, and may close in winter. We check road conditions before the trip. If the road is closed, we talk with you about another meeting point or a new date.

**Where does the car stop for Hehuan Main Peak?**
The Hehuan Main Peak trailhead is at about 29.5K on Highway 14A, with no parking next to it. Cars usually stop at Wuling Pass (about 10 minutes on foot) or Kunyang. For North Peak, walk about 600 m from Xiaofengkou. East Peak and Shimen Mountain start near Songxue Lodge and Hehuan Villa.

**Do I need a permit to hike Hehuanshan?**
Not for Hehuan Main, East, North and West peaks or Shimen Mountain. Since 2020 the area is outside the protected zone and Ren-ai Township is no longer a restricted mountain area. Only camping needs separate approval from Taroko National Park.

**Is there a carpool rule on Hehuanshan on long weekends?**
Yes. From October 24, 2026, on every holiday of 3 or more days, cars between Cuifeng and Dayuling on Highway 14A need at least 3 people from 00:00 to 08:00. Spring rhododendron season weekends have a similar rule. Check the Highway Bureau before you go.

**What should I know about Hehuanshan in winter?**
When there is snow or ice, motorcycles, buses and trucks over 3.5 tonnes are banned, and some stretches are open only to cars with snow chains. The road may also close on icy nights. Check the Highway Bureau road status before you go and keep your plan flexible.

### Dabajian (大霸尖山) hiking shuttle: Taiwan's most recognizable barrel-shaped peak

URL: https://gohike.tw/en/routes/dabajian/

- Trailhead / drop-off: Guanwu / Dalulin Road (觀霧・大鹿林道), Hsinchu
- Drive from Taipei: About 3.5 hours
- Altitude: 3,492 m
- Trip length: 3 days

Scenery: Dabajian's barrel-shaped summit and the Holy Ridge (聖稜線) are among Taiwan's best-known mountain views.
Good for: Hikers with multi-day and long-distance experience who want an advanced high-mountain route.
Getting there: We use the legal drop-off points at Guanwu (觀霧) and on Dalulin Road (大鹿林道). The hike may include a long walk on the forest road, so plan the shuttle and walking time ahead.

Prices (per vehicle, NT$):
- From Taipei, 5-seat: one way NT$6,000, round trip NT$12,000
- From Taipei, 9-seat: one way NT$7,000, round trip NT$14,000
- From Taichung, 5-seat: one way NT$6,000, round trip NT$12,000
- From Taichung, 9-seat: one way NT$7,000, round trip NT$14,000

**Can the car drive into Dalulin Road?**
We use the legal drop-off points at Guanwu (觀霧) and on Dalulin Road (大鹿林道). The hike may include a long walk on the forest road, so include that walking time when you set your pick-up time.

**Can the car drive into Dalu Forest Road for Dabajian?**
No. Dalu Forest Road East has a checkpoint at 0.4K and regular vehicles cannot enter. Cars stop at Guanwu. From there it is about 19 km on foot to the Madala River trailhead (about 7 hours), then about 4 km up to Jiujiu Cabin.

**What permits do I need for Dabajian?**
You need a Shei-Pa National Park entry permit (from 2 months to 5 days before entry). Jiujiu Cabin beds are booked separately through the Forestry Agency Hsinchu branch. The cabin is under renovation until the end of 2028, with only 70 beds a day. Climbing the Dabajian summit is banned.

**How early do I need to leave Taipei for Dabajian?**
Taipei to Guanwu is about 3.5 hours. Day one includes about 7 hours on the forest road before the climb to Jiujiu Cabin, so you usually start walking from Guanwu early in the morning.

### Nanhu Mountain (南湖大山) hiking shuttle: Remote cirques in the Central Range, 3,742 m

URL: https://gohike.tw/en/routes/nanhu/

- Trailhead / drop-off: Shengguang (勝光), Heping, Taichung
- Drive from Taipei: About 3 hours
- Altitude: 3,742 m
- Trip length: 3+ days

Scenery: The Nanhu cirque, glacial landforms and huge mountain views make this one of Taiwan's classic long high-mountain routes.
Good for: Fit hikers with solid high-mountain experience planning three days or more.
Getting there: We mainly drop off and pick up around Shengguang trailhead (勝光). Plan around the timing and weather of a multi-day hike, and check the latest controls and openings.

Prices (per vehicle, NT$):
- From Taipei, 5-seat: one way NT$5,500, round trip NT$11,000
- From Taipei, 9-seat: one way NT$7,000, round trip NT$14,000
- From Taichung, 5-seat: one way NT$6,500, round trip NT$13,000
- From Taichung, 9-seat: one way NT$7,500, round trip NT$15,000

**How do we arrange the return for a multi-day hike like Nanhu?**
Agree your expected finish date and time before you start, and we wait for you around Shengguang trailhead (勝光). Multi-day trips depend on the weather, so if your finish time changes, message us as soon as you have signal.

**Where does the car drop you for Nanhu Mountain?**
Most hikers now start at Shengguang trailhead, on Highway 7A next to the Shengguang police post. Cars park on the road shoulder; the land next to it is private farmland. The old Siyuan Pass trailhead on Forest Road 710 has many landslides and is used less.

**What permits do I need for Nanhu Mountain?**
You need a Taroko National Park entry permit (it is a protected area) and a police mountain permit. Park permits are first come, first served, from 2 months to 5 days before entry, with 60 people a day on the Nanhu route. Yunleng, Shenmazhen and Nanhu cabin beds are booked with the park permit.

**How early do I need to leave Taipei for Nanhu?**
Taipei to Shengguang is about 3 hours. Multi-day hikers often start from the trailhead at 4 or 5 am, so you would leave Taipei in the middle of the night, or stay nearby the night before. In winter Highway 7A may need chains or close, so leave extra time.

### Qilai South Peak & Nanhua (奇萊南華) hiking shuttle: Open grassy ridges, 3,358 m

URL: https://gohike.tw/en/routes/qilai/

- Trailhead / drop-off: Yuntian Temple trailhead (雲天宮登山口), Ren-ai, Nantou
- Drive from Taipei: About 4.5 hours
- Altitude: 3,358 m
- Trip length: 2 days

Scenery: Around Qilai South Peak and Nanhua Mountain (南華山) you get wide alpine grass slopes, ridges and a sea of clouds.
Good for: Hikers with good fitness who want to move up from longer hikes to the Baiyue (百岳).
Getting there: From 2026 the trail starts at Yuntian Temple (雲天宮). The old Tunyuan (屯原) section, 0 to 3K, is closed by landslides. The road to Yuntian Temple is rough, so check that the Nenggao Trail (能高越嶺) is open. Plan two days or more.

Prices (per vehicle, NT$):
- From Taipei, 5-seat: one way NT$6,000, round trip NT$12,000
- From Taipei, 9-seat: one way NT$7,000, round trip NT$14,000
- From Taichung, 5-seat: one way NT$5,000, round trip NT$10,000
- From Taichung, 9-seat: one way NT$6,000, round trip NT$12,000

**Do we need to check the road to the Qilai South Peak trailhead first?**
Yes. The Nenggao Trail (能高越嶺) and the road to the trailhead sometimes close because of conditions. We check how far we can reach before the trip.

**Which trailhead is used for Qilai South Peak and Nanhua now?**
From January 1, 2026, the trail starts at Yuntian Temple (雲天宮). The old Tunyuan section from 0 to 3K is closed by landslides, and the Tunyuan service station has moved to Yuntian Temple. The new start adds about 350 m of climbing and 1.5 to 2 hours.

**Can a car reach the Yuntian Temple trailhead?**
Official information says small cars can get there. But the road from Highway 14 at about 99K is bumpy and in poor shape, the Forestry Agency recommends a high-clearance vehicle or a shuttle, and you must park in the designated lot. Check the latest road conditions before you go.

**What permits do I need for Qilai South Peak and Nanhua?**
Book Tianchi Lodge beds or tent sites from 60 to 5 days before your stay; the lottery is 30 days before. Qilai South Peak is inside Taroko National Park and needs a park entry permit. Nanhua Mountain does not. No police mountain permit has been needed since 2020.

### Jiaming Lake (嘉明湖) hiking shuttle: A blue lake high in the mountains

URL: https://gohike.tw/en/routes/jiaming/

- Trailhead / drop-off: Xiangyang (向陽), Haiduan, Taitung
- Drive from Taipei: About 7–8 hours
- Altitude: 3,310 m
- Trip length: 3 days

Scenery: Jiaming Lake is known for its alpine lake, with forest, grass slopes and high ridges on the way.
Good for: Hiking groups who love alpine scenery and can handle several long days of walking.
Getting there: The trailhead is at Xiangyang (向陽) in Taitung, about 7 to 8 hours from Taipei. If you are flying in, leave enough time for the drive and rest.

Prices (per vehicle, NT$):
- From Taipei, 5-seat: one way NT$8,000, round trip NT$16,000
- From Taipei, 9-seat: one way NT$10,000, round trip NT$20,000
- From Taichung, 5-seat: one way NT$8,000, round trip NT$16,000
- From Taichung, 9-seat: one way NT$10,000, round trip NT$20,000

**How long is the drive from Taipei to the Jiaming Lake trailhead?**
Xiangyang trailhead (向陽) is in Taitung, about 7 to 8 hours from Taipei. If you have just arrived in Taiwan, rest a night before you go, or make the drive part of day one.

**Where does the car drop you for Jiaming Lake?**
At Xiangyang National Forest Recreation Area, 154.5K on Highway 20. The recreation area is closed for works and only serves as a way through to the trail, with no parking inside. From the Xiangyang hiking station it is 4.3 km to Xiangyang Cabin and 13 km to the lake.

**Is the Southern Cross-Island Highway open for Jiaming Lake?**
The western section, from Meishankou in Kaohsiung to Xiangyang, is closed Tuesday to Thursday. On other days you can enter 07:00 to 14:00 and must be out by 17:00. Coming up from Chishang or Haiduan in Taitung does not use this section. Check the Highway Bureau before you go.

**What permits do I need for Jiaming Lake?**
You need a cabin or tent site booking (from 60 to 5 days before your stay, lottery 30 days before) and a police mountain permit. Jiaming Lake is not in a national park, so no park permit. Single-day hikes need a separate permit: at most 10 people, start no earlier than 03:00 and finish by 17:00.

### Songluo Lake (松蘿湖) hiking shuttle: A misty lake deep in the forest

URL: https://gohike.tw/en/routes/songluo/

- Trailhead / drop-off: Songluo Lake trailhead, Datong, Yilan
- Drive from Taipei: About 2 hours
- Altitude: 1,300 m
- Trip length: Day trip, 2 days

Scenery: A lake ringed by forest, with mirror reflections. In rain and mist it has a moody forest-lake feel.
Good for: Visitors who enjoy forest, lakes and camping, and have hiked muddy trails before.
Getting there: In Datong, Yilan (宜蘭大同), about 2 hours from Taipei. Check the last stretch of road and the weather; the trail gets muddy when wet.

Prices (per vehicle, NT$):
- From Taipei, 5-seat: one way NT$5,000, round trip NT$10,000
- From Taipei, 9-seat: one way NT$6,000, round trip NT$12,000
- From Taichung, 5-seat: one way NT$6,000, round trip NT$12,000
- From Taichung, 9-seat: one way NT$7,000, round trip NT$14,000

**Can we still go to Songluo Lake when it rains?**
The last stretch of road and the trail both depend on the weather, and the trail gets muddy when wet. We check the road to the trailhead before the trip. In bad weather we suggest a new date.

**Where is the Songluo Lake trailhead, and can a car get there?**
It is at the end of the Yulan tea farm road in Datong, Yilan, next to a big water tank. Turn off Highway 7 at about 100K onto Benjue Road. Navigation apps sometimes send cars toward Xianuoying, where they get stuck. The trailhead only has room for 6 or 7 cars.

**Do I need a permit for Songluo Lake?**
Yes, a police mountain permit (入山證). Apply online, or in person on the day at the Datong police post at about 102K on Highway 7.

**How long is the hike to Songluo Lake?**
5.4 km each way, out and back. About 7 hours round trip with a light pack, or 4 to 5 hours up with a heavy pack. The trail is very muddy, so rain boots are a good idea.

### Jiali Mountain (加里山) hiking shuttle: Miaoli's classic mid-elevation hike

URL: https://gohike.tw/en/routes/jiali/

- Trailhead / drop-off: Luchang (鹿場), Nanzhuang, Miaoli
- Drive from Taipei: About 2.5 hours
- Altitude: 2,220 m
- Trip length: Day trip

Scenery: Cedar forest, rocky trail sections and a summit view, typical of a mid-elevation forest hike.
Good for: Hikers who enjoy forest walks and have good fitness and basic scrambling skills.
Getting there: We mainly drop off and pick up at the trailhead around Luchang (鹿場), Nanzhuang, Miaoli. The mountain road is narrow, so confirm the pick-up point and return time in advance.

Prices (per vehicle, NT$):
- Quoted per trip; ask us for a price

**What should we confirm before a Jiali Mountain shuttle?**
The mountain road around Luchang (鹿場) is narrow. Confirm the pick-up point and your expected finish time with us in advance, so you don't wait long for the ride back.

**Which trailhead do people use for Jiali Mountain?**
Most use Luchang trailhead, in Luchang village, Nanzhuang, behind Jiali Mountain B&B: 6.8 km round trip, about 7 to 9 hours. You can also do a 9.6 km loop from the Dapin trailhead. Tour buses cannot enter.

**Do I need a permit for Jiali Mountain?**
No. Jiali Mountain needs no mountain permit.

### Luoma traverse (羅馬縱走) hiking shuttle: A forest and ridge traverse

URL: https://gohike.tw/en/routes/luoma/

- Trailhead / drop-off: Siyuan Pass and Mashi Bridge (思源埡口・馬鰣橋), Highway 7A
- Trip length: 1-day traverse

Scenery: Forest, ridges and nature around Luoyewei Mountain (羅葉尾山) and Mawuzuoyejun Mountain (馬武佐野郡山).
Good for: Hikers with mid-elevation traverse experience who want a full day of long-distance hiking.
Getting there: First confirm your direction, start and end point. Different entry and exit points can change the vehicle plan and the price.

Prices (per vehicle, NT$):
- From Taipei, 5-seat: one way NT$5,500, round trip NT$11,000, same-day return NT$9,000
- From Taipei, 9-seat: one way NT$7,000, round trip NT$14,000, same-day return NT$12,000
- From Taichung, 5-seat: one way NT$6,000, round trip NT$12,000, same-day return NT$10,000
- From Taichung, 9-seat: one way NT$7,000, round trip NT$14,000, same-day return NT$12,000

**The traverse starts and ends in different places. How does the shuttle work?**
We drop you at the start and pick you up at the end, so you don't need to go back for a car. Tell us your direction when you ask for a quote; different entry and exit points affect the vehicle plan and the price.

**Where does the Luoma traverse start and finish?**
Usually you start at the old Siyuan police post (about 45.6K on Highway 7A) and finish at Mashi Bridge (about 50.6K, near Shengguang). The two ends are about 5 km apart by road. The traverse is about 10 to 12 km and takes 8 to 9 hours.

**Can I do the Luoma traverse by bus?**
Kuo-Kuang buses 1751 and 1764 reach Siyuan, but the last bus back leaves around 2:30 pm. Most day traversers finish later than that, so you need other transport.

### Gaodao traverse (高島縱走) hiking shuttle: Cedar forest and mid-elevation ridges

URL: https://gohike.tw/en/routes/gaodao/

- Trailhead / drop-off: Gaotai Mountain trailheads (高台山)
- Trip length: Day trip

Scenery: Cedar forest, ridges and a rolling trail from Gaotai Mountain (高台山) to the Daotian Mountain (島田山) range.
Good for: Experienced hikers who want a longer forest traverse.
Getting there: Confirm the exact entry and exit points at Gaotai Mountain and the other end, and set your pick-up time in advance.

Prices (per vehicle, NT$):
- From Taipei, 5-seat: same-day return NT$6,500
- From Taipei, 9-seat: same-day return NT$8,000
- From Taichung, 5-seat: same-day return NT$6,500
- From Taichung, 9-seat: same-day return NT$8,000

**Where do we get on and off for the Gaodao traverse?**
We confirm the actual trailhead based on your route, and agree the pick-up time and place with you before the trip.

**Where is the Gaodao traverse, and where do you start?**
Around Nalo village in Jianshi, Hsinchu. Take County Road 60 over Shishan Bridge and follow the Gaotai Mountain Campground signs. Most hikers start at Trailhead 1 and come back to the same place, about 9 to 10 km and 6 to 8 hours.

**How much water should I carry for the Gaodao traverse?**
There is no water on the route, so carry 2 to 3 liters. Fog often rolls in by afternoon, so start early.

### Taman Mountain (塔曼山) hiking shuttle: A high forest walk in northern Taiwan

URL: https://gohike.tw/en/routes/taman/

- Trailhead / drop-off: Lalashan area (拉拉山), Fuxing, Taoyuan
- Altitude: 2,130 m
- Trip length: Day trip

Scenery: Old-growth forest, moss, tree roots across the trail and damp forest life.
Good for: Hikers who enjoy forest photography and nature watching, and are fine on slippery trails.
Getting there: Usually in and out via trailheads in the Lalashan (拉拉山) area. We confirm how far the car can reach and the local road conditions in advance.

Prices (per vehicle, NT$):
- From Taipei, 5-seat: same-day return NT$6,500
- From Taipei, 9-seat: same-day return NT$8,000
- From Taichung, 5-seat: same-day return NT$7,500
- From Taichung, 9-seat: same-day return NT$8,000

**Can the car reach the Taman Mountain trailhead?**
Taman Mountain is usually hiked from trailheads in the Lalashan (拉拉山) area. Before the trip we confirm how far the car can reach and the local road conditions.

**Where do you start the Taman Mountain hike?**
At the Big Water Tank trailhead: Highway 7 to Lalashan, then Shang Baling and Yunding Campground, then follow the signs. It is 3 km each way, about 3 hours up and 2 hours down. Only 3 to 5 cars fit near the trailhead, and mid-size or large buses cannot get there.

**Do I need a permit for Taman Mountain?**
No. But beyond the summit is the Chatianshan Nature Reserve, and entering without approval can bring a fine, so turn back at the summit.

### Beidelaman (北得拉曼) hiking shuttle: Giant trees and a forest trail challenge

URL: https://gohike.tw/en/routes/beidelaman/

- Trailhead / drop-off: Shuitian village (水田部落), Jianshi, Hsinchu
- Trip length: Day trip

Scenery: Giant trees, forest life and a mid-elevation trail, a standout hike in the Hsinchu mountains.
Good for: Hikers with basic trail experience who love giant-tree forest and want more of a challenge.
Getting there: Confirm the mountain road and the exact trailhead before the trip, and leave enough time for the descent and the drive back.

Prices (per vehicle, NT$):
- From Taipei, 5-seat: same-day return NT$6,500
- From Taipei, 9-seat: same-day return NT$8,000
- From Taichung, 5-seat: same-day return NT$7,000
- From Taichung, 9-seat: same-day return NT$9,000

**How much time should we leave for the return from Beidelaman?**
The Hsinchu mountain roads are winding, and there is still a long drive to the city after the hike. When you set the return time, leave enough time for the descent and the drive. We suggest a start time based on your plan.

**Where is the Beidelaman trailhead?**
At the Shuitian Forest Road trailhead above Shuitian village in Jianshi, Hsinchu: County Road 120 toward Xinle, then Shuitian Forest Road (竹58). Cars can get there, but mid-size and large buses cannot. Parking is often full before 7 am on weekends.

**Do I need a permit for Beidelaman?**
No mountain permit is needed. The hike takes about 6 hours round trip, and there are no toilets on the trail.

### Junda Mountain (郡大山) hiking shuttle: Central Range ridge views

URL: https://gohike.tw/en/routes/junda/

- Trailhead / drop-off: Junda Forest Road (郡大林道), Xinyi, Nantou
- Altitude: 3,265 m
- Trip length: 1-day Baiyue

Scenery: Junda Mountain is known for high ridges, bamboo grass slopes and mountain views.
Good for: Hikers with mid-to-high altitude experience who want a one-day Baiyue (百岳).
Getting there: Junda Forest Road (郡大林道) may have limits on road conditions, traffic control, vehicle type and how far vehicles can go. We only list 9-seat prices for now. Your quote says which vehicle carries you, how far it can reach, and whether separate forest-road transport is needed. A regular vehicle may not reach the trailhead.

Prices (per vehicle, NT$):
- From Taipei, 9-seat: round trip NT$18,000, same-day return NT$16,000
- From Taichung, 9-seat: round trip NT$15,000, same-day return NT$13,000

**Can the car drive right to the Junda Mountain trailhead?**
Not always. Junda Forest Road (郡大林道) has road, traffic and vehicle limits, and how far we can reach depends on conditions at the time. Your quote says which vehicle carries you, where it can reach, and whether separate forest-road transport is needed.

**Is Junda Forest Road open to vehicles now?**
The road is managed by the Forestry Agency Nantou branch. The Junda Mountain trailhead is at about 32K, and the agency recommends a high-clearance 4WD. Hours often change and the road sometimes closes for works, so check the Nantou branch road status page before you go.

### Xiakaluo Old Trail, one-way (霞喀羅古道 A 進 B 出) hiking shuttle: A historic trail, end to end

URL: https://gohike.tw/en/routes/xiakaluo-ab/

- Trailhead / drop-off: Yanglao and Shilu (養老・石鹿), Hsinchu
- Trip length: Day trip

Scenery: A historic trail, mountain forest, river valleys and seasonal colors. Some sections are known for autumn maples.
Good for: Groups who enjoy old trails and forest hiking, and have done longer walks before.
Getting there: The big plus of an end-to-end hike is that you don't go back to your start for a car. We arrange different start and end points; the exact meeting points and coverage are listed in your quote.

Prices (per vehicle, NT$):
- From Taipei, 9-seat: round trip NT$14,000, same-day return NT$10,000
- From Taichung, 9-seat: round trip NT$14,000, same-day return NT$10,000

**How does the one-way (A in, B out) shuttle work?**
We drop you at one end of the old trail. After you walk the whole way, the car waits at the other end, so you don't walk back to a car. The exact meeting points and coverage are listed in your quote.

**Where are the two ends of the Xiakaluo Old Trail?**
The Shilu end (0K) is in Wufeng: County Road 122 to Qingquan, then about 45 minutes up the Qingshi farm road. The Yanglao end is in Jianshi, via County Road 60 toward Xiuluan. The trail is about 22 km; the agency estimates about 10 hours.

**Can you walk the whole Xiakaluo Old Trail right now?**
It depends on current notices. The Yanglao end near 21K has closed several times for landslides, and in 2026 a boulder smashed the trestle bridge at 16.2K. Check the Forestry Agency Hsinchu trail notices before you go.

**Do I need a permit for the Xiakaluo Old Trail?**
No mountain permit is needed. Neither end has public transport, and mid-size or large buses cannot enter.

### Xiakaluo Old Trail, out and back (霞喀羅古道 養老進出) hiking shuttle: A walk on a historic forest trail

URL: https://gohike.tw/en/routes/xiakaluo-yanglao/

- Trailhead / drop-off: Yanglao (養老), Jianshi, Hsinchu
- Trip length: Day trip

Scenery: Forest and a historic trail, like the full traverse, but you choose how far to walk before turning back.
Good for: Hikers who want to see the old trail without doing the full end-to-end walk.
Getting there: For Yanglao in-and-out you get on and off at the same meeting area, unlike an end-to-end traverse. We confirm how far we can reach at the Yanglao (養老) end based on the road at the time.

Prices (per vehicle, NT$):
- From Taipei, 9-seat: same-day return NT$8,000
- From Taichung, 9-seat: same-day return NT$8,000

**What is the difference between Yanglao in-and-out and the one-way (A in, B out) route?**
Yanglao in-and-out starts and ends at the same place: you walk in and come back the same way. One-way goes in at one end and out at the other, so it needs two pick-up points.

**What should I know before hiking Xiakaluo from the Yanglao end?**
The Yanglao end near 21K has closed several times for landslides, so check the Forestry Agency Hsinchu notices before you go. No mountain permit is needed, but there is no public transport and mid-size or large buses cannot enter.
